use_case_summary: Avalon runs compliance-sensitive document search and automated support triage for EU banking customers. Primary requirement: all customer PII and model prompt/response logs must be encrypted with customer-controlled keys, key material cannot be exported and must be attestable. They also want per-tenant key separation for multitenant workloads and audit trails forwarded to their SIEM. Latency budget ~150ms P95 for short chat queries; high throughput (1000 QPS) for embeddings/rerank jobs during batch windows.
notes:
- Security-first evaluation. strong preference for customer-managed keys (BYOK) + HSM-backed keys (Azure Managed HSM / AWS CloudHSM / GCP CMEK with HSM protected key material).
- Key requirements they repeated: key rotation policy compatibility, attestation report (FIPS 140-2 Level 2/3 evidence), ability to perform offline import of key material for BYOK, and granular IAM mapping so Redwood service principals can call KMS via VPC endpoints only.
- Proposed integration patterns discussed:
  1) Envelope encryption: Redwood runtime encrypts symmetric data keys with customer CMK on every node; CMK operations via VPC endpoint/private link (no public egress). Logs to CloudTrail / Azure Monitor forwarded to customer's SIEM.
  2) Ephemeral node keys + cached encrypted KV: allow low-latency token generation while master CMK stays in customer's KMS. Discussed TTL for cached decrypted keys and forced rewrap on rotate.
  3) HSM-backed attestation: customer requires Redwood to accept keys from Managed HSMs only or to provide attestation of runtime using customer HSM-backed CMKs. They asked if Redwood supports Azure Managed HSM, AWS CloudHSM-backed KMS CMKs, and GCP KMS with HSM protection.
- Operational asks: show architecture diagram with network flows (VPC peering, PrivateLink), list of service principals / IP ranges, instructions for setting up KMS grants/policies, and example Terraform snippet for BYOK import and CMK grants.
- Compliance: need retention controls for audit logs (7+ years), ability to disable debug logging of raw prompts, and selective redaction before storing embeddings. SOC2 & ISO27001 required; they will ask for POA&M after the POC.
- POC scope: small private deployment in Avalon Azure subscription (eu-west region), bring-your-own-key via Azure Key Vault (Managed HSM) + test of rotation and key-revoke scenario. Evaluate latency impact when KMS operations forced synchronously vs envelope cache.
- Quote from CSO on 1/28: "We cannot accept a solution that requires our key material to leave our control — attestation and BYOK are non-negotiable."
- Action items: share HSM attestation templates, provide sample audit-log forwarding config, arrange POC kickoff with infra on 2026-02-21.
